title: Semantic Release bumps manifests, skips board commits and empty versions
description:
`release.toml` sets no `version_toml` or `version_variables`, so `Cargo.toml:6`, `analysis/pyproject.toml:3` and `web/package.json:4` stay at `0.1.0` while tags reach v0.8.0. `CHANGELOG.md` has 18 version headings, several empty (v0.8.0, v0.5.6, v0.5.5) plus "Chores: kanbus: Commit board state" entries. `semantic-release.yml` has no `timeout-minutes` and installs `python-semantic-release~=10.0` unpinned on each run.

Done when: the three manifests are bumped by the release; `exclude_commit_patterns` drops `chore(kanbus)` and `chore(release)` commits; a release with no user-facing commits produces no version; the workflow has a timeout and a pinned tool version.
